assessments.reasoning: OSI’s license/366 CMS response matches the pinned digest and gives type=license, status=publish and version=3.0. The body specifies “Licensed under the Academic Free License version 3.0” adjacent to the work’s copyright notice and follows it with the copyright grant.

The Index owns its data model and admits a grant with an identifiable text and edition from a controlling source. Record 366 satisfies that test for an active local reference, while SCOPE.md itself makes no edition-specific selection.

challenge.method: Compared the title, content and version field with CMS publication, category and approval metadata. Checked whether the shared author and 3.0 numbering could merge AFL, ordinary OSL and Non-Profit OSL.
challenge.results: The body consistently identifies AFL. Rosen separately names AFL, OSL and NOSL 3.0 and describes Non-Profit OSL as requested by IETF. The CMS category “redundant-with-more-popular”, approved=false, null approval date and empty minutes URL supply no contrary identity and cannot settle a historical board decision.

limitations: Active is the intended local reference classification. CMS publication status supplies no evidence of an existing Index selection, general recommendation, work-specific grant or installation eligibility.
reasoning: OSI CMS record 366 publishes a license titled “Academic Free License v. 3.0” with an edition-specific application notice and operative grants. That publication supports the proposed active reference within the Index’s stated scope.
